closing.summary: Big strengths are vitamin B12, omega 3, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low zinc, low collagen, and the outcome depends heavily on preparation. It is good for blood and oxygen support, hormone health, and bone health because vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and vitamin D and magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with.

scenes.narrationText: 18.6 grams of protein. Essential amino acids score is 9 out of 9, making the protein useful for repair and maintenance. Collagen is only 0.8 grams, weak for connective-tissue protein, so for meats, it is not bringing much connective-tissue protein. Strong protein is expected here, so the rest of the profile decides how high it climbs.
